leftEvidence.title: The assembly weeps and proposes a return to Egypt

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: The whole assembly cries through the night, complains against Moses and Aaron, and asks why the LORD brought them to die.
points.right: Joshua circumcises the generation born in the wilderness because the men who left Egypt died after refusing the LORD’s voice.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: They say wives and children will become prey and propose appointing a leader to return to Egypt.
points.right: Their children are raised in their place and brought into the land.

payload.posture: Numbers records fear for the children; Joshua says those children were raised in place of the refusing generation and brought into the land.

rightEvidence.role: Another spying mission and the delayed inheritance
rightEvidence.title: The children enter after the men of war die in the wilderness

payload.tension: The feared outcome is reversed, but the children still live through the cost of wilderness delay.
payload.title: Children feared as prey and raised in their parents’ place
